messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! friend works... but i need your actual name to find you the perfect role

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man... or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
AVS Aditya Vardhan

avs aditya vardhan... that's a name with some weight to it. sounds like someone who's going places.

where you working these days?
Right now I am in Shipsy. From Monday onwards I would be joining kim.cc

shipsy to kim.cc... making moves! that's the logistics tech to fintech pipeline right there.

found you on linkedin - Lead Software Engineer at Shipsy. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/a-v-s-adityavardhan
Yes

lead engineer at shipsy, jumping to kim.cc... you're moving from logistics tech to fintech at the perfect time. kim.cc's doing some interesting stuff in the credit space. what made you decide to make this switch from logistics to fintech?
There were some troubles and misalignments. I thought to focus on career

misalignments happen... smart to cut losses and focus on what actually moves your career forward. kim.cc's a solid choice for that - fintech's where the real growth is happening right now.

how long you been working total?

3.5 years
  And it's my first company too

3.5 years, one company... that's actually solid foundation building. most people job hop too early, but you stuck it out and made lead. now you're making your first strategic move to kim.cc.

what kind of role you looking for next? staying in engineering or exploring something else?
Engineering where it would be less chaotic

lol "less chaotic"... i feel you. startup chaos can be draining when there's no method to the madness. sounds like you want engineering with actual processes and sanity.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

Bangalore only
  I have my own home and paying emi

makes total sense. home + emi = bangalore locked. smart move buying property early in your career.

so just to confirm - 3.5 years experience + engineering roles + bangalore only... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yes
  Would be open for now as I am going already
  But feel a risk

Yes
  Would be open for now as I am going already
  But feel a risk
  So want to be very sure before I take a dare step

feeling the risk is totally normal - you're jumping from your first company to something new. that's scary as hell but also exactly how careers grow.

here's the thing though - you're not making this move blind anymore. you're in the tal network now. if kim.cc doesn't work out, or if something better pops up, you'll know about it. having options kills the fear.

plus 3.5 years at shipsy... you've got solid experience. you're not some fresher making desperate moves. you're a lead engineer with logistics tech experience moving into fintech. that's a calculated career upgrade, not a dare step.

welcome to the fam! 🔥
Hi

SDE III (Backend) at Locus

Aditya, Locus offers a less chaotic environment in logistics, aligning with your need for structured career growth in Bangalore.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/ETTku

Java Developer-SDE II at Landmark group

Landmark's Java SDE II role uses your backend skills (Java, Spring Boot) in logistics, but may be a less structured environment than you seek.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/HmDuO

Senior Software Engineer at Shakudo

Fintech & less chaos in Bangalore, AVS! Leverage Shipsy & kim.cc experience at Shakudo.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/uaj1M

hey, saw this full-stack role at remotestar in gurgaon

they're in gaming/g-commerce which is an interesting space

but it's gurgaon not bangalore, so probably not for you right now

SDE III - (Platform) at Jumio Corporation

Fintech role at Jumio in Bangalore, offering a less chaotic environment and career growth.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/s5lFm

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

hey, jpmorgan chase has a software engineer III role in bangalore

structured corporate environment, exactly what you wanted for less chaos

tier 1 bank, fintech domain, and matches your 3.5 years experience

jp morgan chase has a java cloud role in bangalore

tier 1 fintech with structured environment - exactly what you wanted

less chaotic than startup life for sure

(IND) Senior, Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech India

Walmart's structured environment & database frameworks team aligns with your need for less chaos, plus it's a tier upgrade from Shipsy/kim.cc.
